text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While headed back to the academy after
an
outing with Agnes Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, have you ever had a stalker?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Because right now, I'm being stalked by
someone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. Act calm and casually look
behind
you... towards the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I do as she says and take a casual glance
behind
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A street lamp dimly flickers to life, and
above it,
a single feathery figure
stands...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did you see it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Correct, a crow. I'm being stalked by a
crow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A few days ago, that same crow got
tangled up in
some discarded fishing
line.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was like a histone wrapped in a strand
of DNA...
No, speaking in terms of
conventional theory, my
description
suffers from a discrepancy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Still, the hierarchical structure of the
nucleosome
has yet to be fully studied.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I seem to have gotten away from
the
original topic of conversation.
Anyway, I think the
crow is stalking me
because I saved it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... Ahhh, you'll understand
soon
enough.
choice_data_list: 放っておいてもいいんじゃ……
choice_data_list_en: Maybe we should just leave it alone...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's make it seem as though
I'm staying
in your office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go to open the curtains in my office,
but as I get
closer, I notice a large heap
of garbage stuck
onto the sill.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! You see now, Trainer? It's a
present from
the crow!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Its stench is strong enough that even I
must pinch
my nose!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Right? It did the same thing to my room.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Without fail, it packs my windowsill with
trash
until it's stuck into the window
frame.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer... How do you think we can
resolve
this situation?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, I'm at a complete
loss!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If this crow were an Umamusume, I'd ask
them to
repay their thanks by becoming
a test subject,
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's a crow! They're not as durable as we
are! The
risk to its safety would be too
great!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, I need your concentrated effort to
get me out
of this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However intelligent it may be, we're
dealing with
a wild bird here, remember?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I highly doubt words are the solution.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well... I suppose there is a possibility it might sense something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll give it a go. You never know
something
until you try it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, crow! Your gratitude is painfully
clear!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You've done more than enough! I'm
incredibly
satisfied! So... you should start
thinking about
yourself first now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crow appears to stare at Agnes
Tachyon for a
moment...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then it swiftly flaps out its wings and
flies away.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh... It seems to have worked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the crow disappears, Agnes
Tachyon is left
with the question of
whether her words were truly

understood.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: While I can't experiment on an actual crow, I can insert a crow's genes into you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And there she goes again, spouting out
some
off-kilter ideas.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you suggesting I eat what it's
offered
me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What kind of person are you?! That
doesn't even
qualify as an experiment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... As my assistant, you should be
nicer to
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I only meant that she act like she'd
accept it, but I
guess she misunderstood
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crow continues bringing gifts for
some days
to follow, but eventually it
stops appearing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon was at first overwhelmed
by the
offerings, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On occasion, there were these pretty
rocks and
things mixed in... I began to
enjoy what I'd find
after a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gazes out the now crow-free window
and
smiles longingly.
